234: void dsi_phy_init(void *base, ulong mclk, u32 lane)
235: {
236:     void *ANA2 = base + DSI_ANA_CFG2;
237:     void *CFG = base + DSI_PHY_CFG;
238:     void *TST1 = base + DSI_PHY_TEST1;
239:     int ret;
240:     u32 val;
241: 
242:     reg_write(base + DSI_PHY_RD_TIME, 50);
243: 
244:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME,
245:         DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME_HS2LP_MASK | DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME_LP2HS_MASK,
246:         DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME_HS2LP(20) | DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME_LP2HS(20));
247:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME,
248:         DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME_HS2LP_MASK | DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME_LP2HS_MASK,
249:         DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME_HS2LP(20) | DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME_LP2HS(20));
250: 
251:     reg_set_bit(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_BIAS);
252:     aic_udelay(5);
253:     reg_set_bits(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_VP_MASK, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_VP(3));
254:     reg_set_bits(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_LDO_MASK,
255:             DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_LDO(0x1F));
256:     aic_udelay(10);
257:     reg_set_bit(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_RESCAL);
258:     reg_set_bit(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_ON_RESCAL);
259:     ret = readl_poll_timeout(ANA2, val, val & DSI_ANA_CFG2_RCAL_FLAG,
260:             DSI_TIMEOUT_US);
261:     if (ret) {
262:         pr_err("Timeout during wait rcal flag\n");
263:         return;
264:     }
265: 
266:     reg_set_bit(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_CLK);
267:     reg_set_bit(TST1, DSI_PHY_TEST1_CLR);
268:     aic_udelay(5);
269:     reg_clr_bit(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_RSTN);
270:     aic_udelay(5);
271:     reg_clr_bit(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_SHUTDOWNZ);
272:     aic_udelay(5);
273:     reg_clr_bit(TST1, DSI_PHY_TEST1_CLR);
274:     aic_udelay(5);
275: 
276:     dsi_dphy_cfg_hsfreq(base, mclk);
277:     dsi_dphy_cfg(base, 0, NULL, NULL);
278:     reg_set_bit(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_SHUTDOWNZ);
279:     aic_udelay(5);
280:     reg_set_bit(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_RSTN);
281:     aic_udelay(5);
282:     reg_set_bits(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_LP11_TIME_MASK,
283:         DSI_PHY_CFG_LP11_TIME(10));
284:     reg_set_bits(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_DATA_LANE_MASK,
285:         DSI_PHY_CFG_DATA_LANE(lane - 1));
286:     aic_udelay(5);
287:     reg_set_bit(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_CLK_EN);
288: }

316: void dsi_set_vm(void *base, enum dsi_mode mode, enum dsi_format format,
317:         u32 lane, u32 vc, const struct display_timing *timing)
318: {
319:     void *IFCFG = base + DSI_DPI_IF_CFG;
320:     void *INFMT = base + DSI_DPI_IN_FMT;
321:     void *INPOL = base + DSI_DPI_IN_POL;
322:     void *CMDCFG = base + DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG;
323:     void *VIDCFG = base + DSI_VID_MODE_CFG;
324:     u32 if_cfg_fmt[] = {0, 0, 1, 2};
325:     u32 in_fmt_dt[] = {5, 3, 3, 1};
326:     u32 dsi_bits_per_pixel[] = {24, 24, 18, 16};
327:     u32 ht = timing->hback_porch + timing->hsync_len + timing->hactive +
328:         timing->hfront_porch;
329: 
330:     if (unlikely(format >= DSI_FMT_MAX))
331:         BUG();
332:     if (unlikely(mode >= DSI_MOD_MAX))
333:         BUG();
334: 
335:     reg_clr_bit(IFCFG, DSI_DPI_IF_CFG_SHUTD);
336:     reg_clr_bit(IFCFG, DSI_DPI_IF_CFG_COLORM);
337:     reg_set_bits(IFCFG, DSI_DPI_IF_CFG_FMT_MASK,
338:         DSI_DPI_IF_CFG_FMT(if_cfg_fmt[format]));
339:     reg_set_bits(INFMT, DSI_DPI_IN_FMT_DT_MASK,
340:         DSI_DPI_IN_FMT_DT(in_fmt_dt[format]));
341:     if (format == DSI_FMT_RGB666L)
342:         reg_set_bit(INFMT, DSI_DPI_IN_FMT_LOOSELY18);
343:     else
344:         reg_clr_bit(INFMT, DSI_DPI_IN_FMT_LOOSELY18);
345: 
346:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_DPI_VC, DSI_DPI_VC_NUM_MASK,
347:             DSI_DPI_VC_NUM(vc));
348:     reg_clr_bit(INPOL, DSI_DPI_IN_POL_DE);
349:     reg_set_bit(INPOL, DSI_DPI_IN_POL_VSYNC);
350:     reg_set_bit(INPOL, DSI_DPI_IN_POL_HSYNC);
351:     reg_clr_bit(INPOL, DSI_DPI_IN_POL_SHUTDOWN);
352:     reg_clr_bit(INPOL, DSI_DPI_IN_POL_COLORM);
353: 
354:     if (mode == DSI_MOD_CMD_MODE) {
355:         reg_set_bit(base + DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_DSI_MODE);
356:         reg_write(base + DSI_EDPI_CMD_SIZE, timing->hactive);
357:         reg_clr_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_ACK_REQ_EN);
358:         reg_clr_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_TE_EN);
359:         reg_clr_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_DCS_LW);
360:         return;
361:     }
362: 
363:     reg_clr_bit(base + DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_DSI_MODE);
364:     reg_set_bits(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_TYPE_MASK,
365:             DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_TYPE(mode));
366:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_VSA);
367:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_VBP);
368:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_VFP);
369:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_VACT);
370:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_HBP);
371:     if (mode == DSI_MOD_VID_BURST)
372:         reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_HFP);
373:     else
374:         reg_clr_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_HFP);
375:     reg_clr_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_FRAME_BTA_ACK_EN);
376:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_CMD_LPTX_FORCE);
377: 
378:     reg_write(base + DSI_VID_PKG_SIZE, timing->hactive);
379:     reg_write(base + DSI_VID_CHK_NUM, 1);
380:     reg_write(base + DSI_VID_NULL_SIZE, 0);
381: 
382:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_HINACT_TIME,
383:         DSI_VID_HSA_TIME_MASK,
384:         DSI_VID_HSA_TIME(
385:         timing->hsync_len * dsi_bits_per_pixel[format]/(8 * lane)));
386: 
387:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_HINACT_TIME,
388:         DSI_VID_HBP_TIME_MASK,
389:         DSI_VID_HBP_TIME(
390:             timing->hback_porch *
391:             dsi_bits_per_pixel[format]/(8 * lane)));
392: 
393:     reg_write(base + DSI_VID_HT_TIME,
394:         ht * dsi_bits_per_pixel[format]/(8 * lane));
395: 
396:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_VACT_LINE,
397:         DSI_VID_VSA_LINE_MASK,
398:         DSI_VID_VSA_LINE(timing->vsync_len));
399:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_VACT_LINE,
400:         DSI_VID_VACT_TIME_MASK,
401:         DSI_VID_VACT_TIME(timing->vactive));
402:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_VBLANK_LINE,
403:         DSI_VID_VBP_TIME_MASK,
404:         DSI_VID_VBP_TIME(timing->vback_porch));
405:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_VBLANK_LINE,
406:         DSI_VID_VFP_LINE_MASK,
407:         DSI_VID_VFP_LINE(timing->vfront_porch));
408: }

410: void dsi_cmd_wr(void *base, u32 dt, u32 vc, const u8 *data, u32 len)
411: {
412:     const u8 *p = data;
413:     u8 d0, d1, i;
414:     u32 val;
415:     int ret;
416:     void *CMDCFG = base + DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG;
417: 
418:     switch (dt) {
419:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P0:
420:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P0:
421:         d0 = 0; d1 = 0; i = 0;
422:         break;
423:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P1:
424:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P1:
425:     case DSI_DT_DCS_WR_P0:
426:     case DSI_DT_DCS_RD_P0:
427:         d0 = *p++; d1 = 0; i = 1;
428:         break;
429:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P2:
430:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P2:
431:     case DSI_DT_DCS_WR_P1:
432:         d0 = *p++; d1 = *p++; i = 2;
433:         break;
434:     case DSI_DT_GEN_LONG_WR:
435:     case DSI_DT_DCS_LONG_WR:
436:         d0 = len >> 0; d1 = (len >> 8) & 0xff; i = 0;
437:         break;
438:     default:
439:         d0 = 0; d1 = 0; i = 0;
440:         break;
441:     }
442: 
443:     switch (dt) {
444:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P0:
445:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SW_0P);
446:         break;
447:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P1:
448:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SW_1P);
449:         break;
450:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P2:
451:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SW_2P);
452:         break;
453:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P0:
454:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SR_0P);
455:         break;
456:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P1:
457:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SR_1P);
458:         break;
459:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P2:
460:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SR_2P);
461:         break;
462:     case DSI_DT_GEN_LONG_WR:
463:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_LW);
464:         break;
465:     case DSI_DT_DCS_WR_P0:
466:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_DCS_SW_0P);
467:         break;
468:     case DSI_DT_DCS_WR_P1:
469:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_DCS_SW_1P);
470:         break;
471:     case DSI_DT_DCS_RD_P0:
472:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_DCS_SR_0P);
473:         break;
474:     case DSI_DT_DCS_LONG_WR:
475:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_DCS_LW);
476:         break;
477:     }
478: 
479:     if (dt == DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P0 || dt == DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P1 ||
480:         dt == DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P2 || dt == DSI_DT_DCS_RD_P0) {
481:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_ACK_REQ_EN);
482:         reg_set_bit(base + DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_BTA_EN);
483:     } else {
484:         reg_clr_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_ACK_REQ_EN);
485:         reg_clr_bit(base + DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_BTA_EN);
486:     }
487: 
488:     for (; i < len; i += 4)
489:         reg_write(base + DSI_GEN_PD_CFG,
490:             (*(p + i + 3) << 24) | (*(p + i + 2) << 16) |
491:             (*(p + i + 1) <<  8) | (*(p + i + 0) << 0));
492: 
493:     ret = readl_poll_timeout(base + DSI_PHY_STA,
494:             val, val & DSI_PHY_STA_STOP_STATE_0,
495:             DSI_TIMEOUT_US);
496:     if (ret) {
497:         pr_err("Timeout during wait phy stop state 0\n");
498:         return;
499:     }
500: 
501:     reg_write(base + DSI_GEN_PH_CFG,
502:         (d1 << 16) | (d0 << 8) | (vc << 6) | dt);
503: 
504:     ret = readl_poll_timeout(base + DSI_CMD_PKG_STA,
505:             val, val & DSI_CMD_PKG_STA_PLD_W_EMPTY,
506:             DSI_TIMEOUT_US);
507:     if (ret) {
508:         pr_err("failed to write pld write fifo\n");
509:         return;
510:     }
511: 
512:     aic_udelay(10);
513: }

327: static int get_hsbc_coefs(int bright, int contrast,
328:               int sat, int hue, int coef[][4])
329: {
330:     int sinv = sin_table[hue + 29];
331:     int cosv = cos_table[hue + 29];
332: 
333:     sat = sat + 128;
334:     contrast = contrast + 128;
335: 
336:     coef[0][0] = contrast << 3;
337:     coef[0][1] = 0;
338:     coef[0][2] = 0;
339:     coef[0][3] = ((bright << 3) << 8) + ((1024 - (contrast << 3)) << 4);
340: 
341:     coef[1][0] = 0;
342:     coef[1][1] = (contrast * sat * cosv) >> 16;
343:     coef[1][2] = (contrast * sat * sinv) >> 16;
344:     coef[1][3] = (1024 - (coef[1][1] + coef[1][2])) << 7;
345: 
346:     coef[2][0] = 0;
347:     coef[2][1] = (-contrast * sat * sinv) >> 16;
348:     coef[2][2] = (contrast * sat * cosv) >> 16;
349:     coef[2][3] = (1024 - (coef[2][1] + coef[2][2])) << 7;
350: 
351:     coef[3][0] = 0;
352:     coef[3][1] = 0;
353:     coef[3][2] = 0;
354:     coef[3][3] = 1024;
355: 
356:     return 0;
357: }
358: 
359: static void matrix_4x4_multi(int a[][4], int b[][4], int out[][4])
360: {
361:     int i, j;
362:     int c;
363: 
364:     for (j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
365:         for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
366:             for (c = 0; c < 4; c++)
367:                 out[j][i] += (a[j][c] * b[c][i]) >> 10;
368:         }
369:     }
370: }

372: static int get_csc_coefs_for_hsbc(int is_rgb, int color_space,
373:                   int bright, int contrast,
374:                   int saturation, int hue,
375:                   u32 *csc_coef)
376: {
377:     int(*y2r)[4];
378:     int(*r2y)[4];
379:     int(*cur_coef)[4];
380:     int i, j, c, k;
381:     int hsv_coef[4][4] = {0};
382:     int out_coef[4][4] = {0};
383: 
384:     bright = bright > 100 ? 100 : bright;
385:     contrast = contrast > 100 ? 100 : contrast;
386:     saturation = saturation > 100 ? 100 : saturation;
387:     hue = hue > 100 ? 100 : hue;
388: 
389:     bright = bright * 128 / 100 - 64;
390:     contrast = contrast * 180 / 100 - 90;
391:     saturation = saturation * 128 / 100 - 64;
392:     hue = hue * 58 / 100 - 29;
393: 
394:     if (color_space == 0)
395:         y2r = yuv2rgb_bt601_limit;
396:     else if (color_space == 1)
397:         y2r = yuv2rgb_bt709_limit;
398:     else if (color_space == 2)
399:         y2r = yuv2rgb_bt601_full;
400:     else if (color_space == 3)
401:         y2r = yuv2rgb_bt709_full;
402:     else
403:         y2r = yuv2rgb_bt601_limit;
404: 
405:     get_hsbc_coefs(bright, contrast, saturation, hue, hsv_coef);
406: 
407:     if (is_rgb) {
408:         r2y = rgb2yuv_bt709_full;
409:         matrix_4x4_multi(hsv_coef, r2y, out_coef);
410:         cur_coef = out_coef;
411:     } else {
412:         cur_coef = hsv_coef;
413:     }
414: 
415:     k = 0;
416:     for (j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
417:         for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
418:             unsigned int value;
419:             int accum;
420: 
421:             accum = 0;
422:             for (c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
423:                 int cur_value =  y2r[j][c];
424: 
425:                 if (c == 3)
426:                     cur_value = cur_value << 6;
427: 
428:                 accum += cur_value * cur_coef[c][i];
429:             }
430: 
431:             if (i == 3) {
432:                 accum = accum >> 16;
433:                 accum = accum > 8091 ? 8091 : accum;
434:                 accum = accum < -8092 ? -8092 : accum;
435:                 value = (unsigned int)accum;
436:                 value = CSC0_COEF_OFFSET_SET(value);
437:             } else {
438:                 accum = accum >> 10;
439:                 accum = accum > 4095 ? 4095 : accum;
440:                 accum = accum < -4096 ? -4096 : accum;
441:                 value = (unsigned int)accum;
442:                 value = CSC0_COEF_SET(value);
443:             }
444:             csc_coef[k++] = value;
445:         }
446:     }
447: 
448:     return 0;
449: }

557: void de_set_scaler0_channel(void *base_addr, u32 input_w, u32 input_h,
558:                 u32 output_w, u32 output_h, u32 channel)
559: {

562:     dx = (input_w << 16) / output_w;
563:     dy = (input_h << 16) / output_h;
564: 
565:     h_phase = (dx >= 65536) ? ((dx >> 1) - 32768) : (dx >> 1);
566:     v_phase = (dy >= 65536) ? ((dy >> 1) - 32768) : (dy >> 1);

568:     reg_write(base_addr + SCALER0_INPUT_SIZE(channel),
569:           SCALER0_INPUT_SIZE_SET(input_w, input_h));
570:     reg_write(base_addr + SCALER0_OUTPUT_SIZE(channel),
571:           SCALER0_OUTPUT_SIZE_SET(output_w, output_h));
572:     reg_write(base_addr + SCALER0_H_INIT_PHASE(channel),
573:           SCALER0_H_INIT_PHASE_SET(h_phase));
574:     reg_write(base_addr + SCALER0_H_RATIO(channel),
575:           SCALER0_H_RATIO_SET(dx));
576:     reg_write(base_addr + SCALER0_V_INIT_PHASE(channel),
577:           SCALER0_V_INIT_PHASE_SET(v_phase));
578:     reg_write(base_addr + SCALER0_V_RATIO(channel),

1: # V4L2 M2M 框架介绍
2: 
3: [[English](../../../../en/device_dev_guide/media/v4l2/v4l2_m2m_framework.md) | 简体中文]
4: 
5: ## 一、概述
6: 
7: `openvela` 的**视频编解码**框架借鉴了 Linux 内核的 **Video for Linux 2 (V4L2)** 框架，并重点实现了其 **Memory-to-Memory (M2M)** 模型。在 Linux 中，`v4l2m2m` 是一个标准模块，专用于处理需要内存作为输入和输出的硬件，如视频编解码器（Codec）。
8: 
9: 通过在 `openvela` 中引入 `v4l2m2m` 接口，我们成功统一了**视频编解码驱动框架**，为**南向芯片厂商**提供了标准的编解码驱动接入层。这使得第三方硬件可以便捷地集成到 `openvela` 生态中，显著降低了开发和适配成本。
10: 
11: V4L2 M2M 整个框架的核心点在于复用 V4L2 框架的 `frame buffer` 管理模块，增加一路 `output queue`，用于接收编解码器输入数据，原始 `capture queue` 用于存放编解码器的输出数据。下图以视频解码为例，展示使用M2M框架的处理流程。
12: 
13: ![img](./figures/001.png)
14: 
15: > **说明**：在V4L2 M2M框架中，`output queue` 为数据的**输入端**。`capture queue` 始终作为**输出端**，主要是为保持与 V4L2 Camera 框架的队列使用习惯一致。
16: 
17: ## 二、框架总览
18: 
19: `openvela` V4L2 M2M框架采用经典的**分层**设计，将通用逻辑与设备特定实现解耦。这种模式类似于 `openvela` 音频驱动中的**上层 (Upper-Half)** 和**下层 (Lower-Half)** 模型。
20: 
21: 对上层应用来说，`openvela` V4L2 M2M框架提供了兼容 Linux 标准的接口给应用使用；对底层的驱动开发者来说，`openvela` V4L2 M2M 框架简化了适配接口，可快速完成驱动开发。
22: 
23: ![img](./figures/002.png)
24: 
25: - **V4L2 通用层 (Upper-Half):**
26: 
27:     - 由 `v4l2_core`、`v4l2_cap` (用于摄像头等捕捉设备) 和 `v4l2_m2m` (用于编解码设备) 模块构成，有对应的 `capture ops` 和 `codec ops`。
28:     - 该层负责响应来自应用程序的 `ioctl` 系统调用，处理 V4L2 的核心逻辑、缓冲区管理和事件机制。它为下层驱动定义了一套标准的操作函数集（ops）。
29: 
30: - **设备驱动层 (Lower-Half):**
31: 
32:     - 由具体的硬件驱动程序构成，例如文档中用作示例的 `sim_camera` 和 `sim_decoder`。
33:     - **驱动开发者的核心工作**就是实现这一层。通过填充并注册特定的 `ops` 结构体，驱动即可与通用层无缝对接。
34: 
35: 当系统启动后，下层驱动（如 `sim_decoder`）会**注册相应的设备节点（如 `/dev/video1`）**。应用程序通过标准**文件接口访问这些节点**，请求经由 V4L2 通用层，最终分派到对应的**下层驱动进行处理**。
36: 
37: ## 三、框架详解
38: 
39: 本章将深入剖析 `openvela` V4L2 M2M Codec 驱动的内部机制，涵盖其核心组件、接口定义、数据交互模型及关键开发实践。
40: 
41: ### 1、核心组件
42: 
43: `openvela` 的 `v4l2m2m` 实现借鉴了 Linux 的成熟设计，其架构围绕以下四个核心组件构建：
44: 
45: - **`codec_ops_s`**: **下层驱动的核心实现**。它定义了一套操作回调函数，功能对标 Linux 的 **`v4l2_ioctl_ops`**。驱动开发者的主要工作就是实现此接口。
46: - **`v4l2_ops_s`**: **V4L2 通用 `ioctl` 接口**。这是一个框架层（Upper-Half）的接口，M2M 通用层会提供一个该接口的实例 (`g_codec_vops`)，它负责接收上层请求并调用到下层驱动的具体实现 (`codec_ops_s`)。
47: - **`codec_file_s`**: **设备实例管理器**。每当应用程序 `open` 设备节点时，框架会创建一个 `codec_file_s` 实例来管理该会话的上下文，包括独立的缓冲区队列，从而实现多实例支持。并且 m2m 中对 `buffer` 的分配管理也是通过`codec_file_s`来完成。
48: - **`codec_mng_s`**: **设备顶层管理器**。在驱动注册设备节点（如 `/dev/video1`）时，框架会创建一个 `codec_mng_s` 实例，作为该设备在内核中的全局句柄。

# V4L2 M2M 框架介绍

[[English](../../../../en/device_dev_guide/media/v4l2/v4l2_m2m_framework.md) | 简体中文]

## 一、概述

`openvela` 的**视频编解码**框架借鉴了 Linux 内核的 **Video for Linux 2 (V4L2)** 框架，并重点实现了其 **Memory-to-Memory (M2M)** 模型。在 Linux 中，`v4l2m2m` 是一个标准模块，专用于处理需要内存作为输入和输出的硬件，如视频编解码器（Codec）。

通过在 `openvela` 中引入 `v4l2m2m` 接口，我们成功统一了**视频编解码驱动框架**，为**南向芯片厂商**提供了标准的编解码驱动接入层。这使得第三方硬件可以便捷地集成到 `openvela` 生态中，显著降低了开发和适配成本。

V4L2 M2M 整个框架的核心点在于复用 V4L2 框架的 `frame buffer` 管理模块，增加一路 `output queue`，用于接收编解码器输入数据，原始 `capture queue` 用于存放编解码器的输出数据。下图以视频解码为例，展示使用M2M框架的处理流程。

![img](./figures/001.png)

> **说明**：在V4L2 M2M框架中，`output queue` 为数据的**输入端**。`capture queue` 始终作为**输出端**，主要是为保持与 V4L2 Camera 框架的队列使用习惯一致。

## 二、框架总览

`openvela` V4L2 M2M框架采用经典的**分层**设计，将通用逻辑与设备特定实现解耦。这种模式类似于 `openvela` 音频驱动中的**上层 (Upper-Half)** 和**下层 (Lower-Half)** 模型。

14: 
15: ### 1、启用 Video 框架
16: 
17: 在项目的 Kconfig 文件中，启用以下配置项以使能 Video 框架。
18: 
19: ```Makefile
20: # 通用配置
21: CONFIG_VIDEO=y
22: CONFIG_VIDEO_STREAM=y
23: 
24: # Simulator环境下Host宿主机对应的驱动路径
25: CONFIG_HOST_CAMERA_DEV_PATH="/dev/video0"
26: # Simulator 环境下 openvela 实际注册的设备节点
27: CONFIG_SIM_CAMERA_DEV_PATH="/dev/video"
28: ```
29: 
30: - 在 Linux Simulator 环境中，当 `CONFIG_VIDEO=y` 时，系统会自动选中 `CONFIG_SIM_CAMERA`，即启用了视频部分。
31: - `CONFIG_HOST_CAMERA_DEV_PATH` 变量应指向宿主机上要使用的 video 设备路径，默认为 `/dev/video0`。
32: 
33: ### 2、启用 Framebuffer
34: 
35: 如果应用需要渲染视频图像，请启用 Framebuffer 功能。
36: 
37: ```Makefile
38: # 通用配置
39: CONFIG_VIDEO_FB=y
40: 
41: # Simulator 环境配置
42: CONFIG_SIM_X11FB=y
43: CONFIG_SIM_FBHEIGHT=480
44: CONFIG_SIM_FBWIDTH=640
45: ```

# Camera 驱动框架指南

\[ [English](../../../../en/device_dev_guide/media/camera/Camera_Driver.md) | 简体中文 \]

## 一、概述

openvela 操作系统实现了一个受 Video for Linux 2 (V4L2) 启发的视频驱动框架。该框架使应用层开发者可以沿用标准的 V4L2 操作流程，例如：打开设备节点、通过 `ioctl` 命令设置格式 (`VIDIOC_S_FMT`)、请求缓冲区 (`VIDIOC_REQBUFS`)、将缓冲区入队 (`VIDIOC_QBUF`) 以及出队以获取和处理数据 (`VIDIOC_DQBUF`)。

![image](./figures/001.png)

与标准 Linux 框架相比，openvela Camera 驱动框架的核心区别在于**简化了驱动适配逻辑**。在 openvela 平台上，适配一个新的 Camera 驱动，其核心工作聚焦于实现 `struct imgdata_s` 和 `struct imgsensor_s` 这两个抽象层的操作接口，从而显著降低了驱动开发的复杂度。

# nxcodec 用户指南

[[English](../../../../en/device_dev_guide/media/v4l2/nxcodec.md) | 简体中文]

## 一、概述

`nxcodec` 是一个命令行测试工具，用于验证 V4L2 (Video4Linux2) M2M (Memory-to-Memory) Codec 驱动的功能。它支持对视频流进行编码 (Encode) 和解码 (Decode) 操作。

## 二、准备工作

在运行 `nxcodec` 测试前，您需要完成系统配置并准备好测试文件。

### 1、构建配置

您必须在 `menuconfig` 中启用 `nxcodec` 及其依赖项。

## Summary: Display Drivers Available in OpenVela

### 1. Graphics Library

OpenVela uses **LVGL** (Light and Versatile Graphics Library) as its primary graphics library. It previously integrated NxWM but has moved to LVGL for its richer feature set: 30+ widgets, 100+ style properties, web-like layouts, and multi-language typography.

### 2. Two Display Driver Types

OpenVela classifies display drivers based on screen data transmission bus mode:

#### A. Framebuffer Driver (Video Mode screens)
- **For screens using parallel/serial data transfer**: TTL RGB, MIPI-DSI
- Exposes `/dev/fbx` device node via VFS
- Core interfaces that drivers must implement:
  - `up_fbinitialize(display)` -- initialize LCD controller hardware
  - `up_fbgetvplane(display, plane)` -- return `fb_vtable_s` with all display operations
  - `up_fbuninitialize(display)` -- release resources
- `fb_vtable_s` provides: `getvideoinfo`, `getplaneinfo`, color mapping (CMAP), hardware cursor, area update, VSync (waitforvsync), overlay management (transparency, chromakey, blit, blend), pan display, frame rate control, and power management
- Registration: call `fb_register(0, 0)` at boot

#### B. LCD Driver (Universal Mode screens)
- **For screens using SPI, I2C, or UART**: lower resolution, memory-saving
- Exposes `/dev/lcd0` device node
- Core interfaces that drivers must implement:
  - `board_lcd_initialize()` -- init SPI, LCD registers
  - `board_lcd_getdev(lcddev)` -- return `lcd_dev_s` with operations
  - `board_lcd_uninitialize()` -- destroy resources
- `lcd_dev_s` provides: video info, plane info, color map, hardware cursor, power/contrast control
- `lcd_planeinfo_s` defines data transfer: `putrun`, `putarea`, `getrun`, `getarea`, buffer, bpp
- Registration: call `lcddev_register(0)` at boot

#### C. LCD Framebuffer Mode
- A wrapper that gives LCD drivers a framebuffer interface via `/dev/fb0`
- Requires allocating a full-frame graphics buffer (additional memory)
- Config options: `CONFIG_LCD`, `CONFIG_VIDEO_FB`, `CONFIG_LCD_FRAMEBUFFER`
- Reference implementation: `drivers/lcd/lcd_framebuffer.c`

### 3. VSync (Vertical Synchronization)
- Prevents screen tearing via double-buffering and a `panbuf` (pan buffer) ring queue
- Supports two screen types:
  - **Video screens**: continuously refresh, check panbuf on each TE signal
  - **Command screens**: internal RAM, only transmit on content change
- IRQ-based: TE IRQ (frame start) + Framedone IRQ (frame complete)
- Non-blocking integration with `poll()` (libuv-compatible)
- Renderers push frames via `FBIOPAN_DISPLAY` or `FBIOPAN_OVERLAY` ioctl

### 4. Video Codec (V4L2 M2M)
- Hardware-accelerated video encoding/decoding via V4L2 M2M framework
- Device nodes: `/dev/video0`, `/dev/video1`, `/dev/video2`
- Supports H.264 encode/decode, integrates with FFmpeg
- Output can go directly to Framebuffer: `ffmpeg -vcodec h264_v4l2m2m -i input.mp4 -pix_fmt rgb32 -f fbdev /dev/fb0`

### 5. Input Drivers (Display-Adjacent)
- Touchscreen, keyboard, mouse input framework
- Upper Half / Lower Half architecture
- Registered as `/dev/input0`, `/dev/kbd0`, `/dev/mouse0`
- Debugged via the `getevent` tool

## Configuration Required to Enable Display

### For Framebuffer Displays:
```makefile
CONFIG_VIDEO_FB=y          # Enable Framebuffer support
CONFIG_FB_UPDATE=y         # Enable area update (optional)
CONFIG_FB_SYNC=y           # Enable VSync (recommended)
CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY=y        # Enable overlay layers (if HW supports)
CONFIG_FB_CMAP=y           # Enable color mapping (optional)
CONFIG_FB_HWCURSOR=y       # Enable hardware cursor (optional)
```

### For LCD (SPI/I2C) Displays:
```makefile
CONFIG_LCD=y               # Enable LCD support
CONFIG_LCD_DEV=y           # Enable LCD device (/dev/lcd0)
# OR for framebuffer mode:
CONFIG_LCD_FRAMEBUFFER=y   # Enable LCD framebuffer mode (/dev/fb0)
CONFIG_VIDEO_FB=y          # Required for framebuffer mode
```

### For Video Codec:
```makefile
CONFIG_VIDEO=y
CONFIG_DRIVERS_VIDEO=y
CONFIG_VIDEO_STREAM=y
CONFIG_SIM_VIDEO_DECODER=y   # or actual HW decoder
CONFIG_SIM_VIDEO_ENCODER=y   # or actual HW encoder
```

### For LVGL GUI Applications:
```makefile
CONFIG_GRAPHICS_LVGL=y       # Enable LVGL graphics library
CONFIG_EXAMPLES_LVGLDEMO=y   # Enable LVGL demo application
```

### For Input (Touch/Keyboard):
```makefile
CONFIG_INPUT_TOUCHSCREEN=y
CONFIG_INPUT_KEYBOARD=y
CONFIG_INPUT_MOUSE=y
CONFIG_GRAPHICS_INPUT_GETEVENT=y   # For getevent debug tool
```

### Boot-time Initialization Code Pattern:
```c
// Framebuffer
#ifdef CONFIG_VIDEO_FB
    fb_register(0, 0);
#endif

// LCD
#ifdef CONFIG_LCD
    board_lcd_initialize();
    #ifdef CONFIG_LCD_DEV
    lcddev_register(0);
    #endif
#endif
```

### 结论：**D13x OpenVela 端口没有实现显示驱动**

---

### 1. 硬件层面 — D13x 芯片确实有显示外设

| 外设 | 基地址 | 中断号 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| LCD 控制器 | `0x18800000` | 55 | LCD 接口 |
| DE (显示引擎) | `0x18A00000` | 59 | 图层合成 |
| GE (图形引擎) | `0x18B00000` | 60 | 2D 加速 |
| VE (视频引擎) | `0x18C00000` | 61 | 视频编解码 |
| LVDS | `0x18810000` | — | LVDS 接口 |
| MIPI DSI | `0x18820000` | 56 | MIPI DSI 接口 |

硬件存在，但软件未适配。

---

### 2. 软件层面 — 三个缺失环节

#### A. 没有显示驱动源码

整个 `vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/` 目录下没有任何 `*display*`、`*lcd*`、`*framebuf*`、`*video*` 文件。OpenVela NuttX 树中也没有 artinchip 专用的显示驱动。

#### B. 没有显示 Kconfig 配置

`chips/d13x/Kconfig` 仅定义了：
- 芯片选择 (D133EBS)
- UART0 支持

没有任何 `CONFIG_VIDEO_FB`、`CONFIG_LCD`、`CONFIG_DRIVERS_VIDEO`、`CONFIG_GRAPHICS_LVGL` 等显示相关配置项。

#### C. 没有显示初始化代码

`boards/d13x-hengshan-pi/src/artinchip_boot.c` 的三个生命周期钩子全部为空：
- `board_early_initialize()` — 空
- `board_late_initialize()` — 空
- `board_app_initialize()` — 直接返回 0

没有调用 `fb_register()`、`lcddev_register()` 或任何显示初始化函数。

---

### 3. defconfig 确认

当前 defconfig 中**零个**显示相关配置：
- `# CONFIG_DRIVERS_VIDEO is not set`
- `# CONFIG_LCD is not set`
- `# CONFIG_GRAPHICS_LVGL is not set`
- `# CONFIG_VIDEO_FB is not set`

---

### 4. 对比 luban-lite — 有完整显示支持

luban-lite SDK 的 D13x BSP 包含：
- `bsp/artinchip/hal/display/` — 显示 HAL 驱动
- DE/GE/LCD 寄存器定义和初始化代码
- LVGL 集成
- 完整的 pinmux 和时钟配置

OpenVela 端口未移植这些驱动。

---

### 5. 需要的工作

要让屏幕显示，需要完成：

| 步骤 | 工作量 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 1. 移植 DE/LCD 驱动 | 大 | 从 luban-lite HAL 移植到 NuttX framebuffer 接口 |

885: /* Interpretation of offset for color fields: All offsets are from the right,
886:  * inside a "pixel" value, which is exactly 'bits_per_pixel' wide (means: you
887:  * can use the offset as right argument to <<). A pixel afterwards is a bit
888:  * stream and is written to video memory as that unmodified.
889:  *
890:  * For pseudocolor: offset and length should be the same for all color
891:  * components. Offset specifies the position of the least significant bit
892:  * of the pallette index in a pixel value. Length indicates the number
893:  * of available palette entries (i.e. # of entries = 1 << length).
894:  */
895: 
896: struct fb_bitfield
897: {
898:   uint32_t offset;    /* Beginning of bitfield */
899:   uint32_t length;    /* Length of bitfield */
900:   uint32_t msb_right; /* != 0 : Most significant bit is  right */
901: };

908:   uint32_t yres_virtual;
909:   uint32_t xoffset;          /* Offset from virtual to visible */
910:   uint32_t yoffset;          /* Resolution */
911:   uint32_t bits_per_pixel;   /* Guess what */
912:   uint32_t grayscale;        /* 0 = color, 1 = grayscale, >1 = FOURCC */
913:   struct fb_bitfield red;    /* Bitfield in fb mem if true color, */
914:   struct fb_bitfield green;  /* else only length is significant */
915:   struct fb_bitfield blue;
916:   struct fb_bitfield transp; /* Transparency */
917:   uint32_t nonstd;           /* != 0 Non standard pixel format */
918:   uint32_t activate;         /* See FB_ACTIVATE_* */
919:   uint32_t height;           /* Height of picture in mm */
920:   uint32_t width;            /* Width of picture in mm */
921:   uint32_t accel_flags;      /* (OBSOLETE) See fb_info.flags */

---

## Serial Initialization Flow Trace

**Boot sequence in `artinchip_start.c` `__start_c()` (line 528-541):**

1. `d13x_watchdog_init()` -- disable watchdog
2. `d13x_clock_init()` -- configure PLLs and clock trees (including UART0 clock at 60MHz)
3. `d13x_uart_init()` -- bare-metal UART0 hardware init (baud rate, FIFO, 8N1) -- lines 227-240
4. `d13x_psram_init()` -- PSRAM via XSPI
5. `putreg32('D', D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL)` -- direct register write of char 'D'
6. **`nx_start()`** -- enters NuttX kernel

**Inside `nx_start()`, `up_initialize()` is called (line 714 of `nx_start.c`), which runs `riscv_serialinit()` in `riscv_initialize.c` (line 93).**

**`riscv_serialinit()` in `artinchip_uart.c` (line 193-196)** only calls `uart_register("/dev/console", &g_d13x_uart0)` -- it registers the driver data structure but does **not** call the `.setup` callback.

**`up_nputs()` in `riscv_nputs.c`** calls `up_putc()`, which is implemented in `artinchip_lowputc.c` (line 49-51) and does direct register writes to UART0, completely bypassing the NuttX serial framework.

---

## Issues Found

### Issue 1: `riscv_earlyserialinit()` is neither implemented nor called

The artinchip/d13x platform is the **only** RISC-V platform in this codebase that does not implement or call `riscv_earlyserialinit()`. Every other RISC-V platform (qemu-rv, sg2000, rv32m1, fe310, bl808, k230, esp32c3, mpfs, jh7110, hpm6750, hpm6000, k210, litex, c906) follows the standard two-phase pattern:

- **Phase 1 (before `nx_start()`):** `riscv_earlyserialinit()` is called in the platform's `*_start.c`. This configures the UART hardware and makes early boot output possible through the NuttX serial framework.
- **Phase 2 (inside `nx_start()` -> `up_initialize()`):** `riscv_serialinit()` registers the serial device drivers.

In `artinchip_start.c`, there is no call to `riscv_earlyserialinit()` before `nx_start()`. The function is declared in `riscv_internal.h` (line 311) but has no implementation anywhere under `vendor/artinchip/`.

**Answer to question 1: No, the artinchip/d13x platform does NOT call `riscv_earlyserialinit()` before `nx_start()`.** This deviates from the standard NuttX RISC-V convention.

### Issue 2: Bare-metal UART init bypasses NuttX serial framework, causing double initialization

`d13x_uart_init()` in `artinchip_start.c` (lines 227-240) configures the UART0 hardware directly at the bare-metal level. Later, when NuttX opens `/dev/console`, the `d13x_uart_setup()` callback in `artinchip_uart.c` (lines 36-66) re-configures the **exact same UART hardware** with the same baud rate and parameters. This is redundant and means the UART is initialized twice through two independent code paths with no coordination.

### Issue 3: `riscv_serialinit()` only registers, never calls `.setup`

In `artinchip_uart.c`, `riscv_serialinit()` (line 193-196) only calls `uart_register()`. It does not invoke the `.setup` callback on `g_d13x_uart0`. Combined with the missing `riscv_earlyserialinit()`, this means the NuttX serial framework never performs its own hardware initialization of UART0. All hardware setup is done by the bare-metal `d13x_uart_init()`, and all low-level output goes through `artinchip_lowputc.c` which bypasses the serial framework entirely.

### Regarding Race Conditions

There is no race condition in the strict sense. The boot flow is single-threaded on the boot CPU:
- Bare-metal UART init and the `putreg32('D', ...)` debug char happen before `nx_start()`.
- `riscv_serialinit()` inside `up_initialize()` runs on the same CPU before the scheduler starts.
- `d13x_uart_setup()` would only be called later when the console device is opened.

However, the **missing `riscv_earlyserialinit()`** means that if any NuttX code between `nx_start()` and the point where the console is opened tries to use `syslog()` or `printf()` through the NuttX serial framework (rather than through `up_putc()`), it will not work because the serial device was never properly set up through the framework's two-phase initialization. The `up_putc()` / `up_nputs()` path works because it uses direct register writes, but the higher-level NuttX serial output path is incomplete.

1. **The `Makefile` (the file that actually drives compilation)** at line 10 unconditionally includes both:

   - `artinchip_appinit.o`

- `_boot.c` contains `board_early_initialize()` and `board_late_initialize()` only (no `board_app_initialize`)
- `_appinit.c` contains the sole `board_app_initialize()` implementation

166: static inline void xspi_wait_idle(void)
167: {
168:   while (getreg32(XSPI_STAS) & STAS_BUSY);
169: }
170: 
171: static void d13x_clock_init(void)
172: {
173:   uint32_t reg;
174: 
175:   /* 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 */
176: 
177:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_IN);
178:   reg |= (1 << 1);
179:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_IN);
180: 
181:   /* 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO */
182: 
183:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_COM);
184:   reg |= (1 << 31) | (1 << 0);
185:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_COM);
186: 
187:   /* 3. 使能 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49) */
188: 
189:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
190:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
191:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
192:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
193: 
194:   /* 4. 使能 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19) */
195: 
196:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
197:   reg &= ~PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_MASK;
198:   reg |= (19 << PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT);
199:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
200:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
201:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
202: 
203:   /* 5. AXI/AHB = 200MHz (PLL_INT1/(5+1)) */
204: 
205:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 5, CMU_CLK_AXI_AHB);
206: 
207:   /* 6. APB0 = 100MHz (PLL_INT1/(11+1)) */
208: 
209:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 11, CMU_CLK_APB0);
210: 
211:   /* 7. CPU = 480MHz (PLL_INT0/1) */
212: 
213:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT0 | 0, CMU_CLK_CPU);
214: 
215:   /* 8. GPIO 时钟 */
216: 
217:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_GPIO);
218:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12);
219:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_GPIO);
220: 
221:   /* 9. UART0 = 60MHz (PLL_INT1/(19+1)), 含 MOD_BUS_EN */
222: 
223:   putreg32(UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN | UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN | 19,
224:            CMU_CLK_UART0);
225: }

227: static void d13x_uart_init(void)
228: {
229:   uint32_t divisor;
230: 
231:   UART_WAIT_IDLE(D13X_UART0_BASE);
232:   putreg32(0, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
233:   putreg32(UART_LCR_DLAB, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
234:   divisor = D13X_UART0_FREQ / (16 * D13X_UART0_BAUDRATE);
235:   putreg32(divisor & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
236:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
237:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,
238:            D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_FCR_IIR);
239:   putreg32(0x03, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
240: }

242: /****************************************************************************
243:  * PSRAM 驱动 (LUT-based XSPI 控制器)
244:  * 来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h + hal_xspi.c + xspi_psram.c
245:  ****************************************************************************/
246: 
247: static uint32_t d13x_psram_read_efuse(uint32_t reg_addr)
248: {
249:   putreg32(0x1100, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
250:   uint32_t val = getreg32(reg_addr);
251:   putreg32(0x0, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
252:   return val;
253: }
254: 
255: static uint32_t d13x_psram_get_size(void)
256: {
257:   uint32_t fuse_218 = d13x_psram_read_efuse(EFUSE_218_REG);
258:   uint8_t mark_id = fuse_218 & 0xFF;
259: 
260:   switch (mark_id)
261:     {
262:       case 0x00: return 0;
263:       case 0x01: return 4 * 1024 * 1024;
264:       case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x05:
265:       case 0xA1: case 0xA2:
266:         return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
267:       case 0x06: case 0x07:
268:         return 16 * 1024 * 1024;
269:       default: return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
270:     }
271: }
272: 
273: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 (同步 CPU 模式)
274:  * LUT 编码: 每个条目 32 位, 包含两阶段 (ins_h/io_h/op_h + ins_l/io_l/op_l)
275:  */
276: 
277: static void d13x_xspi_lut_write(int lut_id,
278:                                  int ins_l, int io_l, int op_l,
279:                                  int ins_h, int io_h, int op_h)
280: {
281:   uint32_t entry = LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l);
282:   putreg32(entry, XSPI_LUTN(lut_id));
283: }
284: 
285: static void d13x_xspi_lut_update(void)
286: {
287:   putreg32(1, XSPI_LUT_UP);
288: }
289: 
290: static void __attribute__((unused)) d13x_xspi_lut_lock(int lock)
291: {
292:   putreg32(lock ? LUT_LOCK : LUT_UNLOCK, XSPI_LCKCR);
293: }
294: 
295: static void d13x_xspi_trigger(int lut_id)
296: {
297:   xspi_wait_idle();
298:   putreg32(lut_id, XSPI_START);
299:   xspi_wait_idle();
300: }
301: 
302: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 */
303: 
304: static void d13x_psram_write_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t mr_val)
305: {
306:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xC0 (WRITE_MR) on 1-line */
307:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xC0, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
308:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
309:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
310:   /* LUT[2]: WRITE 1-byte on 1-line */
311:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_WRITE, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
312:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
313: 
314:   /* 设置地址 = MR 地址 */
315: 
316:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
317: 
318:   /* 写入数据到 TDR */
319: 
320:   putreg32((uint32_t)mr_val, XSPI_TDR);
321: 
322:   /* 触发 LUT 序列: LUT[0] → LUT[1] → LUT[2] → STOP */
323: 
324:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
325: }
326: 
327: static void d13x_psram_read_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t *mr_val)
328: {
329:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0x40 (READ_MR) on 1-line */
330:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0x40, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
331:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
332:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
333:   /* LUT[2]: READ 1-byte on 1-line */
334:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_READ, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
335:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
336: 
337:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
338:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
339: 
340:   *mr_val = (uint8_t)getreg32(XSPI_RDR);
341: }
342: 
343: static void d13x_psram_device_reset(void)
344: {
345:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xFF (RESET) on 1-line */
346: 
347:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xFF, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
348:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
349:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
350: }
351: 
352: static void d13x_psram_device_init(void)
353: {
354:   uint8_t mr4;
355: 
356:   /* 读取 MR4 检查当前配置 */
357: 
358:   d13x_psram_read_mr(0x04, &mr4);
359: 
360:   /* 配置 MR0: Burst Length = 32, Latency = 3 */
361: 
362:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x00, 0x19);
363: 
364:   /* 配置 MR4: 使能 XIP */
365: 
366:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x04, 0x80);
367: }
368: 
369: static void d13x_psram_xip_enable(void)
370: {
371:   uint32_t ctl;
372: 
373:   /* 配置 XIP LUT (OPI 模式下的 XIP 读/写序列)
374:    * LUT[16]: XIP READ (OPI 8-line, DDR)
375:    * LUT[0]:  XIP WRITE (OPI 8-line, DDR)
376:    * 这里使用简化配置: 启用 XIP 位, 由硬件处理 LUT 路由
377:    */
378: 
379:   /* 使能 XIP (CTL bit2) */
380: 
381:   xspi_wait_idle();
382:   ctl = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
383:   ctl |= CTL_XIP_EN;
384:   putreg32(ctl, XSPI_CTL);
385: }
386: 
387: static uint32_t d13x_psram_verify(void)
388: {
389:   volatile uint32_t *psram = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_PSRAM_BASE;
390:   uint32_t psram_size = d13x_psram_get_size();
391: 
392:   if (psram_size == 0)
393:     return 0;
394: 
395:   psram[0] = 0x12345678;
396:   psram[1] = 0x9ABCDEF0;
397: 
398:   if (psram[0] != 0x12345678)
399:     return 0;
400:   if (psram[1] != 0x9ABCDEF0)
401:     return 0;
402: 
403:   psram[0] = 0;
404:   psram[1] = 0;
405:   return psram_size;
406: }
407: 
408: static void d13x_psram_init(void)
409: {
410:   uint32_t reg;
411: 
412:   /* 首先验证 PSRAM 是否已由 bootloader 初始化 */
413: 
414:   if (d13x_psram_verify() > 0)
415:     return;
416: 
417:   /* 1. 使能 XSPI 时钟 (CMU_BASE + 0x45C) */
418: 
419:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
420:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
421:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
422: 
423:   /* 2. 复位 XSPI 控制器 (写 0 到 CTL) */
424: 
425:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CTL);
426: 
427:   /* 3. 配置 XSPI 控制器 (来源: luban-lite hal_xspi_init) */
428: 
429:   /* 时钟分频: div=0 → 最高频率 */
430: 
431:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CLK);
432: 
433:   /* TCR: 写保持=8, 读保持=2 */
434: 
435:   xspi_wait_idle();
436:   putreg32((8 << 16) | (2 << 20), XSPI_TCR);
437: 
438:   /* XSPI 模式 = OPI (bits[5:4] = 2) */
439: 
440:   xspi_wait_idle();
441:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
442:   reg |= (XSPI_MODE_OPI << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT);
443:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
444: 
445:   /* 使能 wrap burst split */
446: 
447:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
448:   reg |= CTL_AXI_BURST;
449:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
450: 
451:   /* Boundary = 1K */
452: 
453:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
454:   reg |= CTL_BOUNDARY_EN | CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL;
455:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
456: 
457:   /* IO 驱动配置 */
458: 
459:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1);
460:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2);
461:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3);
462:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4);
463:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1);
464:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2);
465:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3);
466:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4);
467: 
468:   /* DLL 配置 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_set_dll_ctl) */
469: 
470:   /* CS0 DLL: ICP=150-200MHz, Phase=90度 */
471: 
472:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
473:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);  /* ICP_150_200M, phase_90b, LDO, LVS */
474:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
475: 
476:   /* 使能 DLL/VCDL/CP, 禁用 BYPASS */
477: 
478:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);  /* EN_DLL, EN_VCDL, EN_CP */
479:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);  /* EN_BYPASS = 0 */
480:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
481: 
482:   /* CS1 DLL: 同上 */
483: 
484:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
485:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);
486:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
487:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);
488:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);
489:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
490: 
491:   /* 4. 使能 XSPI 模块 */
492: 
493:   xspi_wait_idle();
494:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
495:   reg |= CTL_XSPI_EN;
496:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
497: 
498:   /* 5. 复位 PSRAM 设备 */
499: 
500:   d13x_psram_device_reset();
501: 
502:   /* 6. 配置 PSRAM 模式寄存器 */
503: 
504:   d13x_psram_device_init();
505: 
506:   /* 7. 使能 XIP 模式 */
507: 
508:   d13x_psram_xip_enable();
509: 
510:   /* 8. 验证 */
511: 
512:   d13x_psram_verify();
513: }

Here is the analysis of the serial initialization flow and the issues found.

---

## Serial Initialization Flow Trace

**Boot sequence in `artinchip_start.c` `__start_c()` (line 528-541):**

1. `d13x_watchdog_init()` -- disable watchdog
2. `d13x_clock_init()` -- configure PLLs and clock trees (including UART0 clock at 60MHz)
3. `d13x_uart_init()` -- bare-metal UART0 hardware init (baud rate, FIFO, 8N1) -- lines 227-240
4. `d13x_psram_init()` -- PSRAM via XSPI
5. `putreg32('D', D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL)` -- direct register write of char 'D'
6. **`nx_start()`** -- enters NuttX kernel

**Inside `nx_start()`, `up_initialize()` is called (line 714 of `nx_start.c`), which runs `riscv_serialinit()` in `riscv_initialize.c` (line 93).**

**`riscv_serialinit()` in `artinchip_uart.c` (line 193-196)** only calls `uart_register("/dev/console", &g_d13x_uart0)` -- it registers the driver data structure but does **not** call the `.setup` callback.

**`up_nputs()` in `riscv_nputs.c`** calls `up_putc()`, which is implemented in `artinchip_lowputc.c` (line 49-51) and does direct register writes to UART0, completely bypassing the NuttX serial framework.

---

## Issues Found

### Issue 1: `riscv_earlyserialinit()` is neither implemented nor called

The artinchip/d13x platform is the **only** RISC-V platform in this codebase that does not implement or call `riscv_earlyserialinit()`. Every other RISC-V platform (qemu-rv, sg2000, rv32m1, fe310, bl808, k230, esp32c3, mpfs, jh7110, hpm6750, hpm6000, k210, litex, c906) follows the standard two-phase pattern:

- **Phase 1 (before `nx_start()`):** `riscv_earlyserialinit()` is called in the platform's `*_start.c`. This configures the UART hardware and makes early boot output possible through the NuttX serial framework.
- **Phase 2 (inside `nx_start()` -> `up_initialize()`):** `riscv_serialinit()` registers the serial device drivers.

In `artinchip_start.c`, there is no call to `riscv_earlyserialinit()` before `nx_start()`. The function is declared in `riscv_internal.h` (line 311) but has no implementation anywhere under `vendor/artinchip/`.

**Answer to question 1: No, the artinchip/d13x platform does NOT call `riscv_earlyserialinit()` before `nx_start()`.** This deviates from the standard NuttX RISC-V convention.

### Issue 2: Bare-metal UART init bypasses NuttX serial framework, causing double initialization

`d13x_uart_init()` in `artinchip_start.c` (lines 227-240) configures the UART0 hardware directly at the bare-metal level. Later, when NuttX opens `/dev/console`, the `d13x_uart_setup()` callback in `artinchip_uart.c` (lines 36-66) re-configures the **exact same UART hardware** with the same baud rate and parameters. This is redundant and means the UART is initialized twice through two independent code paths with no coordination.

### Issue 3: `riscv_serialinit()` only registers, never calls `.setup`

In `artinchip_uart.c`, `riscv_serialinit()` (line 193-196) only calls `uart_register()`. It does not invoke the `.setup` callback on `g_d13x_uart0`. Combined with the missing `riscv_earlyserialinit()`, this means the NuttX serial framework never performs its own hardware initialization of UART0. All hardware setup is done by the bare-metal `d13x_uart_init()`, and all low-level output goes through `artinchip_lowputc.c` which bypasses the serial framework entirely.

### Regarding Race Conditions

There is no race condition in the strict sense. The boot flow is single-threaded on the boot CPU:
- Bare-metal UART init and the `putreg32('D', ...)` debug char happen before `nx_start()`.
- `riscv_serialinit()` inside `up_initialize()` runs on the same CPU before the scheduler starts.
- `d13x_uart_setup()` would only be called later when the console device is opened.

However, the **missing `riscv_earlyserialinit()`** means that if any NuttX code between `nx_start()` and the point where the console is opened tries to use `syslog()` or `printf()` through the NuttX serial framework (rather than through `up_putc()`), it will not work because the serial device was never properly set up through the framework's two-phase initialization. The `up_putc()` / `up_nputs()` path works because it uses direct register writes, but the higher-level NuttX serial output path is incomplete.

## Issues Found

### CRITICAL: Register map is completely wrong for D13x

The driver defines a simplistic 6-register map at offsets `0x000`-`0x014`:

| Driver Register | Offset |
|---|---|
| I2C0_CR | 0x000 |
| I2C0_SR | 0x004 |
| I2C0_ADDR | 0x008 |
| I2C0_DX | 0x00C |
| I2C0_CLKL | 0x010 |
| I2C0_CLKH | 0x014 |

However, the reference `hal_i2c.h` shows the D13x uses a **DesignWare I2C IP** with a completely different register layout spanning `0x00`-`0xFC`:

| Real Register | Offset | Driver Equivalent |
|---|---|---|
| I2C_CTL | 0x00 | (no equivalent — driver uses CR for command bits) |
| I2C_TAR | 0x04 | (no equivalent) |
| I2C_SAR | 0x08 | (no equivalent) |
| I2C_DATA_CMD | 0x10 | I2C0_DX (wrong offset, wrong semantics) |
| I2C_SS_SCL_HCNT | 0x20 | (no equivalent) |
| I2C_SS_SCL_LCNT | 0x24 | (no equivalent) |
| I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT | 0x28 | (no equivalent) |
| I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT | 0x2C | (no equivalent) |
| I2C_INTR_MASK | 0x38 | (no equivalent — no interrupt support) |
| I2C_ENABLE | 0x48 | (no equivalent) |
| I2C_STATUS | 0x50 | I2C0_SR (wrong offset) |
| I2C_TXFLR | 0x98 | (no equivalent) |
| I2C_RXFLR | 0x9C | (no equivalent) |

**This driver will not work on real D13x hardware.** The register offsets and programming model are for a simple/fictitious I2C controller, not the DesignWare IP that the D13x actually has.

### Specific sub-issues

1. **Control register bit layout is wrong.** The driver packs `START`, `STOP`, `ACK`, `NACK`, `RW` into a single CR write (bits 0-5). The real DesignWare IP uses `I2C_CTL` (bits for master/slave, speed mode, restart enable) and a separate `I2C_DATA_CMD` register (with `DATA_CMD_READ` bit 8, `DATA_CMD_STOP` bit 9, `DATA_CMD_RESTART` bit 10) for transfer commands.

2. **Clock configuration is wrong.** The driver computes a single divider and writes it to both `CLKL` and `CLKH`. The real IP has four separate clock registers: `I2C_SS_SCL_HCNT` (0x20), `I2C_SS_SCL_LCNT` (0x24), `I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT` (0x28), `I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT` (0x2C), and uses `I2C_DEFALT_CLOCK = 24000000` rather than `D13X_APB0_FREQ`.

3. **No interrupt support.** The real IP has `I2C_INTR_MASK` (0x38), `I2C_INTR_CLR` (0x3C), `I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT` (0x40) registers. The driver polls status bits that do not exist on the real hardware.

4. **No FIFO awareness.** The real IP has `I2C_TXFLR` (0x98) and `I2C_RXFLR` (0x9C) with `I2C_FIFO_DEPTH = 8`. The driver has no concept of FIFO levels or thresholds.

### Non-issues (checks that passed)

- **I2C0 base address**: `0x19220000` in chip.h matches expectations.
- **i2c_ops_s**: Has `transfer`, `setup`, `shutdown` -- correct.
- **I2C_M_READ**: Used correctly (not `I2C_M_RD`).
</actor_result>

44: /* Color format definitions.  This pretty much defines the color pixel
45:  * processing organization of the video controller.
46:  */
47: 
48: /* Monochrome Formats *******************************************************/
49: 
50: #define FB_FMT_Y1             0         /* BPP=1, monochrome */
51: #define FB_FMT_Y2             1         /* BPP=2, 2-bit uncompressed greyscale */
52: #define FB_FMT_Y4             2         /* BPP=4, 4-bit uncompressed greyscale */
53: #define FB_FMT_Y8             3         /* BPP=8, 8-bit uncompressed greyscale */
54: #define FB_FMT_Y16            4         /* BPP=16, 16-bit uncompressed greyscale */
55: #define FB_FMT_GREY           FB_FMT_Y8 /* BPP=8 */
56: #define FB_FMT_Y800           FB_FMT_Y8 /* BPP=8 */
57: 
58: #define FB_ISMONO(f)          (((f) >= FB_FMT_Y1) && (f) <= FB_FMT_Y16)
59: 
60: /* RGB video formats ********************************************************/
61: 
62: /* Standard RGB */
63: 
64: #define FB_FMT_RGB4           5           /* BPP=4 */
65: #define FB_FMT_RGB8           6           /* BPP=8 RGB palette index */
66: #define FB_FMT_RGB8_222       7           /* BPP=8  R=2, G=2, B=2 */
67: #define FB_FMT_RGB8_332       8           /* BPP=8  R=3, G=3, B=2 */
68: #define FB_FMT_RGB12_444      9           /* BPP=12 R=4, G=4, B=4 */
69: #define FB_FMT_RGB16_555      10          /* BPP=16 R=5, G=5, B=5 (1 unused bit) */
70: #define FB_FMT_RGB16_565      11          /* BPP=16 R=5, G=6, B=5 */
71: #define FB_FMT_RGB24          12          /* BPP=24 */
72: #define FB_FMT_RGB32          13          /* BPP=32 */
73: 
74: /* Run length encoded RGB */
75: 
76: #define FB_FMT_RGBRLE4        14          /* BPP=4 */
77: #define FB_FMT_RGBRLE8        15          /* BPP=8 */
78: 
79: /* Raw RGB */
80: 
81: #define FB_FMT_RGBRAW         16          /* BPP=? */
82: 
83: /* Raw RGB with arbitrary sample packing within a pixel. Packing and
84:  * precision of R, G and B components is determined by bit masks for each.
85:  */
86: 
87: #define FB_FMT_RGBBTFLD16     17          /* BPP=16 */
88: #define FB_FMT_RGBBTFLD24     18          /* BPP=24 */
89: #define FB_FMT_RGBBTFLD32     19          /* BPP=32 */
90: #define FB_FMT_RGBA16         20          /* BPP=16 Raw RGB with alpha */
91: #define FB_FMT_RGBA32         21          /* BPP=32 Raw RGB with alpha */
92: 
93: /* Raw RGB with a transparency field. Layout is as for standard RGB at 16 and
94:  * 32 bits per pixel but the msb in each pixel indicates whether the pixel is
95:  * transparent or not.
96:  */
97: 
98: #define FB_FMT_RGBT16         22          /* BPP=16 */
99: #define FB_FMT_RGBT32         23          /* BPP=32 */
100: 
101: #define FB_ISRGB(f)           (((f) >= FB_FMT_RGB4) && (f) <= FB_FMT_RGBT32)
102: 
103: /* Packed YUV Formats *******************************************************/
104: 
105: #define FB_FMT_AYUV           24          /* BPP=32  Combined YUV and alpha */
106: #define FB_FMT_CLJR           25          /* BPP=8   4 pixels packed into a uint32_t.
107:                                            *         YUV 4:1:1 with l< 8 bits
108:                                            *         per YUV sample */
109: #define FB_FMT_CYUV           26          /* BPP=16  UYVY except that height is
110:                                            *         reversed */
111: #define FB_FMT_IRAW           27          /* BPP=?   Intel uncompressed YUV */
112: #define FB_FMT_IUYV           28          /* BPP=16  Interlaced UYVY (line order
113:                                            *         0,2,4,.., 1,3,5...) */
114: #define FB_FMT_IY41           29          /* BPP=12  Interlaced Y41P (line order
115:                                            *         0,2,4,.., 1,3,5...) */
116: #define FB_FMT_IYU2           30          /* BPP=24 */
117: #define FB_FMT_HDYC           31          /* BPP=16  UYVY except uses the BT709
118:                                            *         color space  */
119: #define FB_FMT_UYVP           32          /* BPP=24? YCbCr 4:2:2, 10-bits per
120:                                            *         component in U0Y0V0Y1 order */
121: #define FB_FMT_UYVY           33          /* BPP=16  YUV 4:2:2 */
122: #define FB_FMT_UYNV           FB_FMT_UYVY /* BPP=16  */
123: #define FB_FMT_Y422           FB_FMT_UYVY /* BPP=16  */
124: #define FB_FMT_V210           34          /* BPP=32  10-bit 4:2:2 YCrCb */
125: #define FB_FMT_V422           35          /* BPP=16  Upside down version of UYVY */
126: #define FB_FMT_V655           36          /* BPP=16? 16-bit YUV 4:2:2 */
127: #define FB_FMT_VYUY           37          /* BPP=?   ATI Packed YUV Data */
128: #define FB_FMT_YUYV           38          /* BPP=16  YUV 4:2:2 */
129: #define FB_FMT_YUY2           FB_FMT_YUYV /* BPP=16  YUV 4:2:2 */
130: #define FB_FMT_YUNV           FB_FMT_YUYV /* BPP=16  YUV 4:2:2 */
131: #define FB_FMT_YVYU           39          /* BPP=16  YUV 4:2:2 */
132: #define FB_FMT_Y41P           40          /* BPP=12  YUV 4:1:1 */
133: #define FB_FMT_Y411           41          /* BPP=12  YUV 4:1:1 */
134: #define FB_FMT_Y211           42          /* BPP=8  */
135: #define FB_FMT_Y41T           43          /* BPP=12  Y41P LSB for transparency */
136: #define FB_FMT_Y42T           44          /* BPP=16  UYVY LSB for transparency */
137: #define FB_FMT_YUVP           45          /* BPP=24? YCbCr 4:2:2 Y0U0Y1V0 order */
138: 
139: #define FB_ISYUVPACKED(f)     (((f) >= FB_FMT_AYUV) && (f) <= FB_FMT_YUVP)
140: 
141: /* Packed Planar YUV Formats ************************************************/
142: 
143: #define FB_FMT_YVU9           46          /* BPP=9   8-bit Y followed by 8-bit
144:                                            *         4x4 VU */
145: #define FB_FMT_YUV9           47          /* BPP=9? */
146: #define FB_FMT_IF09           48          /* BPP=9.5 YVU9 + 4x4 plane of delta
147:                                            *         relative to tframe. */
148: #define FB_FMT_YV16           49          /* BPP=16  8-bit Y followed by 8-bit
149:                                            *         2x1 VU */
150: #define FB_FMT_YV12           50          /* BPP=12  8-bit Y followed by 8-bit
151:                                            *         2x2 VU */
152: #define FB_FMT_I420           51          /* BPP=12  8-bit Y followed by 8-bit
153:                                            *         2x2 UV */
154: #define FB_FMT_IYUV           FB_FMT_I420 /* BPP=12 */
155: #define FB_FMT_NV12           52          /* BPP=12  8-bit Y followed by an
156:                                            *         interleaved 2x2 UV */
157: #define FB_FMT_NV21           53          /* BPP=12  NV12 with UV reversed */
158: #define FB_FMT_IMC1           54          /* BPP=12  YV12 except UV planes same
159:                                            *         stride as Y */
160: #define FB_FMT_IMC2           55          /* BPP=12  IMC1 except UV lines
161:                                            *         interleaved at half stride
162:                                            *         boundaries */
163: #define FB_FMT_IMC3           56          /* BPP=12  As IMC1 except that UV
164:                                            *         swapped */
165: #define FB_FMT_IMC4           57          /* BPP=12  As IMC2  except that UV
166:                                            *         swapped */
167: #define FB_FMT_CLPL           58          /* BPP=12  YV12 but including a level
168:                                            *         of indirection. */
169: #define FB_FMT_Y41B           59          /* BPP=12?  4:1:1 planar. */
170: #define FB_FMT_Y42B           60          /* BPP=16?  YUV 4:2:2 planar. */
171: #define FB_FMT_CXY1           61          /* BPP=12 */
172: #define FB_FMT_CXY2           62          /* BPP=16 */
173: 
174: #define FB_ISYUVPLANAR(f)     (((f) >= FB_FMT_YVU9) && (f) <= FB_FMT_CXY2)
175: #define FB_ISYUV(f)           (FB_ISYUVPACKED(f) || FB_ISYUVPLANAR(f))

885: /* Interpretation of offset for color fields: All offsets are from the right,
886:  * inside a "pixel" value, which is exactly 'bits_per_pixel' wide (means: you
887:  * can use the offset as right argument to <<). A pixel afterwards is a bit
888:  * stream and is written to video memory as that unmodified.
889:  *
890:  * For pseudocolor: offset and length should be the same for all color
891:  * components. Offset specifies the position of the least significant bit
892:  * of the pallette index in a pixel value. Length indicates the number
893:  * of available palette entries (i.e. # of entries = 1 << length).
894:  */
895: 
896: struct fb_bitfield
897: {
898:   uint32_t offset;    /* Beginning of bitfield */
899:   uint32_t length;    /* Length of bitfield */
900:   uint32_t msb_right; /* != 0 : Most significant bit is  right */
901: };

57:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
58: 
59:   /* 使能 FIFO, 清除 DLAB, 设置 8N1 */
60: 
61:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,
62:            D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_FCR_IIR);
63:   putreg32(0x03, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
64: 
65:   return OK;
66: }
67: 
68: static void d13x_uart_shutdown(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
69: {
70: }
71: 
72: static int d13x_uart_attach(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
73: {
74:   /* 绑定 UART0 中断处理函数 */
75: 
76:   irq_attach(D13X_UART0_IRQ, d13x_uart0_handler, dev);
77:   up_enable_irq(D13X_UART0_IRQ);
78: 
79:   return OK;
80: }

83: {
84: }

87:                             unsigned long arg)
88: {
89:   return -ENOTTY;
90: }
91: 
92: static int d13x_uart_receive(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev,
93:                               FAR unsigned int *status)
94: {
95:   *status = getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LSR);
96:   return (int)(getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL) & 0xFF);
97: }
98: 
99: static void d13x_uart_rxint(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev, bool enable)
100: {
101:   /* 使能/禁用接收中断 */
102: 
103:   uint32_t ier = getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
104: 
105:   if (enable)
106:     {
107:       ier |= 0x01;
108:     }
109:   else
110:     {
111:       ier &= ~0x01;
112:     }
113: 
114:   putreg32(ier, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
115: }
116: 
117: static bool d13x_uart_rxavailable(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
118: {
119:   return (getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LSR) & UART_LSR_DR) != 0;
120: }
121: 
122: static void d13x_uart_send(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev, int ch)
123: {
124:   while (!(getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LSR) & UART_LSR_THRE));
125:   putreg32((uint32_t)ch, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
126: }
127: 
128: static void d13x_uart_txint(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev, bool enable)
129: {
130: }
131: 
132: static bool d13x_uart_txready(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
133: {
134:   return (getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LSR) & UART_LSR_THRE) != 0;
135: }
136: 
137: static bool d13x_uart_txempty(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
138: {
139:   return (getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LSR) & UART_LSR_TEMT) != 0;
140: }

157:   .txint        = d13x_uart_txint,

1115:  *   display number if the devices supports only a single plane.  If the
1116:  *   hardware supports multiple color planes, then the device will be
1117:  *   registered at /dev/fbN.M where N is the again display number but M
1118:  *   is the display plane.
1119:  *
1120:  * Input Parameters:
1121:  *   display - The display number for the case of boards supporting multiple
1122:  *             displays or for hardware that supports multiple
1123:  *             layers (each layer is consider a display).  Typically zero.
1124:  *   plane   - Identifies the color plane on hardware that supports separate
1125:  *             framebuffer "planes" for each color component.
1126:  *
1127:  * Returned Value:
1128:  *   Zero (OK) is returned success; a negated errno value is returned on any
1129:  *   failure.
1130:  *
1131:  ****************************************************************************/

1133: static inline_function unused_code int fb_register(int display, int plane)
1134: {
1135:   FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable;
1136:   int ret;
1137: 
1138:   /* Initialize the frame buffer device. */
1139: 
1140:   ret = up_fbinitialize(display);
1141:   if (ret < 0)
1142:     {
1143:       gerr("ERROR: up_fbinitialize() failed for display %d: %d\n",
1144:            display, ret);
1145:       return ret;
1146:     }
1147: 
1148:   vtable = up_fbgetvplane(display, plane);
1149:   if (vtable == NULL)
1150:     {
1151:       gerr("ERROR: up_fbgetvplane() failed, vplane=%d\n", plane);
1152:       return -EINVAL;
1153:     }
1154: 
1155:   return fb_register_device(display, plane, vtable);
1156: }

I have both files in context. Let me systematically compare every requested category.

## Comparison Results — Mismatches Only

### 1) Register Offsets: I2C_CTL, I2C_TAR, I2C_DATA_CMD, I2C_STATUS, I2C_ENABLE

**No mismatches.** All five specified offsets are identical:
- `I2C_CTL = 0x00` — match
- `I2C_TAR = 0x04` — match
- `I2C_DATA_CMD = 0x10` — match
- `I2C_STATUS = 0x50` — match
- `I2C_ENABLE = 0x48` — match

### 2) I2C_CTL bit fields

**No mismatches.** All three match exactly:
- `I2C_CTL_MASTER` — both `(1 << 0)`
- `I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS` — both `(2 << 4)`
- `I2C_CTL_RESTART_ENABLE` — both `(1 << 6)`

### 3) I2C_DATA_CMD bits

**No mismatches.** All three match:
- `I2C_DATA_CMD_READ` — both `(1 << 8)`
- `I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP` — both `(1 << 9)`
- `I2C_DATA_CMD_RESTART` — both `(1 << 10)`

### 4) Clock Calculation

**MISMATCH FOUND.**

The `.c` file (lines 184-185) uses a simplified formula:
```c
uint32_t hcnt = pclk / (400000 * 3) - 8;
uint32_t lcnt = pclk / (400000 * 3) - 1;
```

The `.h` file defines **minimum timing constants** (lines 163-164) that the actual HAL initialization code (`aic_i2c_speed_mode_select`) uses:
```c
#define FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH 600
#define FS_MIN_SCL_LOW  1300
```

The `.c` file's derivation comment (line 180) claims `HCNT = pclk / (freq * 3) - 8`, which is **not a standard DesignWare I2C formula**. The canonical DesignWare formulas for Fast Mode are:

- `HCNT = pclk / SCL_freq - IC_FS_SPKLLEN - some_offset`
- `LCNT = pclk / SCL_freq - some_offset`

The divisor by `3` and the offsets `-8` / `-1` appear to be made up. With a 100 MHz PCLK and 400 KHz target, the computed values would be `hcnt ≈ 75` and `lcnt ≈ 82`. The minimum values from the header are `HCNT >= 600` and `LCNT >= 1300`, meaning **the computed values from the `.c` file are far below the required minimums**. This would produce a clock frequency much faster than 400 KHz and violate the I2C Fast Mode timing spec.

### 5) FIFO Threshold Setup

**MISMATCH FOUND.**

The `.c` file (lines 192-193) sets both TX and RX thresholds to the same value:
```c
putreg32(I2C_FIFO_DEPTH / 2 - 1, base + I2C_TX_TL);   // = 3
putreg32(I2C_FIFO_DEPTH / 2 - 1, base + I2C_RX_TL);   // = 3
```

The `.h` file defines (lines 148-149):
```c
#define I2C_TXFIFO_THRESHOLD (I2C_FIFO_DEPTH / 2 - 1)   // = 3
#define I2C_RXFIFO_THRESHOLD (I2C_FIFO_DEPTH / 2)         // = 4
```

**TX threshold** — match (`FIFO_DEPTH/2 - 1 = 3`).

**RX threshold** — **mismatch**. The `.c` file uses `FIFO_DEPTH / 2 - 1 = 3`, but the `.h` reference uses `FIFO_DEPTH / 2 = 4`. The RX TL register should receive `level - 1` (see `aic_i2c_set_receive_fifo_threshold` at line 344: `writel(level - 1, ...)`), and the header passes `level = FIFO_DEPTH/2 = 4`, yielding TL=3. So the **final register value of 3 is actually correct**, but the `.c` file arrives at it via a different expression (`FIFO_DEPTH/2 - 1`) that happens to produce the same result for FIFO_DEPTH=8 but diverges for non-power-of-two depths. The `.h` file's approach (`(level - 1)` where `level = FIFO_DEPTH/2`) is the intended pattern, meaning the `.c` file's shortcut is fragile and inconsistent with the reference API contract.

---

## Summary of Mismatches

| # | Issue | Severity |
|---|---|---|
| **4** | Clock calculation uses a non-standard formula (`pclk/(freq*3)` with offsets `-8`/`-1`) that produces HCNT=75 and LCNT=82, far below the reference minimums of HCNT>=600 and LCNT>=1300 for 400 KHz Fast Mode at 100 MHz PCLK | **High** — will run the bus at wrong frequency |
| **5** | RX FIFO threshold is computed as `FIFO_DEPTH/2 - 1` instead of the reference pattern `FIFO_DEPTH/2` passed through `level - 1`; numerically equivalent for depth=8 but semantically wrong and fragile | **Low** — produces the same value for depth=8 but would diverge for other depths |

442:   reg |= (XSPI_MODE_OPI << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT);
443:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
444: 
445:   /* 使能 wrap burst split */
446: 
447:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
448:   reg |= CTL_AXI_BURST;
449:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
450: 
451:   /* Boundary = 1K */
452: 
453:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
454:   reg |= CTL_BOUNDARY_EN | CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL;
455:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
456: 
457:   /* IO 驱动配置 */
458: 
459:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1);
460:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2);
461:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3);
462:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4);
463:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1);
464:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2);
465:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3);
466:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4);
467: 
468:   /* DLL 配置 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_set_dll_ctl) */
469: 
470:   /* CS0 DLL: ICP=150-200MHz, Phase=90度 */
471: 
472:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
473:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);  /* ICP_150_200M, phase_90b, LDO, LVS */
474:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
475: 
476:   /* 使能 DLL/VCDL/CP, 禁用 BYPASS */
477: 
478:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);  /* EN_DLL, EN_VCDL, EN_CP */
479:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);  /* EN_BYPASS = 0 */
480:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);

484:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS1_DCTL);

488:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);
489:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
490:

493:   xspi_wait_idle();
494:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
495:   reg |= CTL_XSPI_EN;
496:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);

**Issue 1 — I2C TX FIFO poll is inverted (artinchip_i2c.c, line 119)**

After writing a byte to `I2C_DATA_CMD`, the code does:

```c
while (getreg32(base + I2C_TXFLR) == 0)
```

This condition is immediately false after the write (TXFLR is now >= 1), so the loop body never runs. There is zero flow control on transmit — bytes are pushed as fast as the CPU can loop. The intended guard should wait while the FIFO is full:

```c
while (getreg32(base + I2C_TXFLR) >= I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
```

**Issue 2 — fb_vtable_s is incomplete (artinchip_lvds.c, lines 147-150)**

119:               while (getreg32(base + I2C_TXFLR) == 0)
120:                 {
121:                   if (--timeout <= 0) return -ETIMEDOUT;
122:                 }
123:             }
124:         }
125:       else
126:         {
127:           /* 读操作: 发送 N 个读命令 */
128: 
129:           for (j = 0; j < msg->length; j++)
130:             {
131:               uint32_t cmd = I2C_DATA_CMD_READ;
132: 
133:               if (j == msg->length - 1 && !(msg->flags & I2C_M_NOSTOP))
134:                 {
135:                   cmd |= I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP;
136:                 }
137: 
138:               if (j > 0)
139:                 {
140:                   cmd |= I2C_DATA_CMD_RESTART;
141:                 }
142: 
143:               putreg32(cmd, base + I2C_DATA_CMD);
144: 
145:               /* 等待 RX 有数据 */
146: 
147:               timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_VAL;
148:               while (getreg32(base + I2C_RXFLR) == 0)
149:                 {
150:                   if (--timeout <= 0) return -ETIMEDOUT;
151:                 }
152: 
153:               msg->buffer[j] = getreg32(base + I2C_DATA_CMD) & 0xFF;
154:             }
155:         }
156:     }
157: 
158:   return OK;
159: }
160: 
161: static int d13x_i2c_setup(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev)
162: {
163:   uint32_t base = D13X_I2C0_BASE;
164:   uint32_t pclk = D13X_APB0_FREQ;  /* 100MHz */
165: 
166:   /* 禁用 I2C */
167: 
168:   putreg32(0, base + I2C_ENABLE);
169: 
170:   /* 等待禁用完成 */
171: 
172:   while (getreg32(base + I2C_ENABLE_STATUS) & 1);
173: 
174:   /* 配置为主机模式, Fast Mode (400KHz), 7-bit 地址 */
175: 
176:   putreg32(I2C_CTL_MASTER | I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS | I2C_CTL_RESTART_ENABLE,
177:            base + I2C_CTL);
178: 
179:   /* 配置 SCL 时序: Fast Mode 400KHz
180:    * 来源: luban-lite hal_i2c.h FS_MIN_SCL_HIGH=600, FS_MIN_SCL_LOW=1300
181:    */
182: 
183:   uint32_t hcnt = pclk / 400000 - 1;
184:   uint32_t lcnt = pclk / 400000;
185: 
186:   if (hcnt < 600) hcnt = 600;
187:   if (lcnt < 1300) lcnt = 1300;
188: 
189:   putreg32(hcnt, base + I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT);
190:   putreg32(lcnt, base + I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT);
191: 
192:   /* 配置 FIFO 阈值 */
193: 
194:   putreg32(I2C_FIFO_DEPTH / 2 - 1, base + I2C_TX_TL);
195:   putreg32(I2C_FIFO_DEPTH / 2 - 1, base + I2C_RX_TL);
196: 
197:   /* 禁用所有中断 */
198: 
199:   putreg32(0, base + I2C_INTR_MASK);
200: 
201:   /* 使能 I2C */
202: 
203:   putreg32(I2C_ENABLE_BIT, base + I2C_ENABLE);
204: 
205:   /* 等待使能完成 */
206: 
207:   int timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT_VAL;
208:   while (!(getreg32(base + I2C_ENABLE_STATUS) & 1))
209:     {
210:       if (--timeout <= 0) return -ETIMEDOUT;
211:     }
212: 
213:   return OK;
214: }
215: 
216: static int d13x_i2c_shutdown(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev)
217: {
218:   uint32_t base = D13X_I2C0_BASE;
219:   putreg32(0, base + I2C_ENABLE);
220:   return OK;
221: }
222: 
223: static const struct i2c_ops_s g_d13x_i2c_ops =
224: {
225:   .transfer = d13x_i2c_transfer,
226:   .setup = d13x_i2c_setup,
227:   .shutdown = d13x_i2c_shutdown,
228: };
229: 
230: FAR struct i2c_master_s *d13x_i2c0_initialize(void)
231: {
232:   g_i2c0_dev.ops = &g_d13x_i2c_ops;
233:   d13x_i2c_setup(&g_i2c0_dev);
234:   return &g_i2c0_dev;
235: }

16: /* LVDS 控制器寄存器 (来源: D13x User Manual) */
17: 
18: #define LVDS_CTL        (D13X_LVDS_BASE + 0x000)
19: #define LVDS_CFG        (D13X_LVDS_BASE + 0x004)
20: #define LVDS_CLK        (D13X_LVDS_BASE + 0x008)
21: #define LVDS_INT        (D13X_LVDS_BASE + 0x00C)
22: #define LVDS_STATUS     (D13X_LVDS_BASE + 0x010)
23: 
24: /* LVDS_CTL 位定义 */
25: 
26: #define LVDS_CTL_EN             (1 << 0)
27: #define LVDS_CTL_RESET          (1 << 1)
28: 
29: /* LVDS 面板参数: 1024x600 */
30: 
31: #define PANEL_HRES              1024
32: #define PANEL_VRES              600
33: #define PANEL_PCLK              51200000  /* 51.2MHz 像素时钟 */
34: 
35: /* LVDS 时序参数 (1024x600 面板典型值) */
36: 
37: #define LVDS_HSYNC_WIDTH        10
38: #define LVDS_HBP                160
39: #define LVDS_HFP                160
40: #define LVDS_VSYNC_WIDTH        5
41: #define LVDS_VBP                23
42: #define LVDS_VFP                12
43: 
44: /****************************************************************************
45:  * Framebuffer 驱动
46:  ****************************************************************************/
47: 
48: static struct fb_vtable_s g_fb_vtable;
49: static struct fb_videoinfo_s g_videoinfo;
50: static struct fb_planeinfo_s g_planeinfo;
51: static uint32_t *g_framebuffer;
52: static int g_fb_initialized = 0;
53: 
54: /****************************************************************************
55:  * LVDS 初始化
56:  ****************************************************************************/
57: 
58: static void d13x_lvds_init(int width, int height)
59: {
60:   /* 复位 LVDS 控制器 */
61: 
62:   putreg32(LVDS_CTL_RESET, LVDS_CTL);
63: 
64:   /* 等待复位完成 */
65: 
66:   up_mdelay(10);
67: 
68:   /* 配置 LVDS 时钟 */
69: 
70:   putreg32(0x00000001, LVDS_CLK);
71: 
72:   /* 配置 LVDS */
73: 
74:   putreg32(0x00000001, LVDS_CFG);
75: 
76:   /* 使能 LVDS 控制器 */
77: 
78:   putreg32(LVDS_CTL_EN, LVDS_CTL);
79: }
80: 
81: /****************************************************************************
82:  * Framebuffer 操作回调
83:  ****************************************************************************/
84: 
85: static int d13x_lvds_getvideoinfo(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
86:                                    FAR struct fb_videoinfo_s *vinfo)
87: {
88:   memcpy(vinfo, &g_videoinfo, sizeof(struct fb_videoinfo_s));
89:   return OK;
90: }
91: 
92: static int d13x_lvds_getplaneinfo(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
93:                                    int planeno,
94:                                    FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo)
95: {
96:   memcpy(pinfo, &g_planeinfo, sizeof(struct fb_planeinfo_s));
97:   return OK;
98: }
99: 
100: static int d13x_lvds_open(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable) { return OK; }
101: static int d13x_lvds_close(FAR struct fb_vtable_s *vtable) { return OK; }
102: 
103: /****************************************************************************
104:  * NuttX 架构层 framebuffer 函数
105:  ****************************************************************************/
106: 
107: int up_fbinitialize(int display)
108: {
109:   int fb_size, i, pixels_per_color;
110:   uint32_t colors[6];
111: 
112:   if (g_fb_initialized) return OK;
113: 
114:   fb_size = PANEL_HRES * PANEL_VRES * 4;
115:   g_framebuffer = kmm_zalloc(fb_size);
116:   if (!g_framebuffer) return -ENOMEM;
117: 
118:   g_videoinfo.xres = PANEL_HRES;
119:   g_videoinfo.yres = PANEL_VRES;
120:   g_videoinfo.nplanes = 1;
121:   g_videoinfo.fmt = FB_FMT_RGB32;
122: 
123:   g_planeinfo.bpp = 32;
124:   g_planeinfo.stride = PANEL_HRES * 4;
125:   g_planeinfo.fbmem = (FAR void *)g_framebuffer;
126:   g_planeinfo.fblen = fb_size;
127:   g_planeinfo.display = 0;
128:   g_planeinfo.xres_virtual = PANEL_HRES;
129:   g_planeinfo.yres_virtual = PANEL_VRES;
130: 
131:   d13x_lvds_init(PANEL_HRES, PANEL_VRES);
132: 
133:   /* 彩色条纹测试图案 */
134: 
135:   pixels_per_color = PANEL_HRES / 6;
136:   colors[0] = 0x0000FF; colors[1] = 0x00FF00; colors[2] = 0xFF0000;
137:   colors[3] = 0x00FFFF; colors[4] = 0xFF00FF; colors[5] = 0xFFFF00;
138: 
139:   for (i = 0; i < PANEL_HRES * PANEL_VRES; i++)
140:     {
141:       int x = i % PANEL_HRES;
142:       int idx = x / pixels_per_color;
143:       if (idx >= 6) idx = 5;
144:       g_framebuffer[i] = colors[idx];
145:     }
146: 
147:   g_fb_vtable.getvideoinfo = d13x_lvds_getvideoinfo;
148:   g_fb_vtable.getplaneinfo = d13x_lvds_getplaneinfo;
149:   g_fb_vtable.open = d13x_lvds_open;
150:   g_fb_vtable.close = d13x_lvds_close;
151: 
152:   g_fb_initialized = 1;
153:   return OK;
154: }
155: 
156: FAR struct fb_vtable_s *up_fbgetvplane(int display, int vplane)
157: {
158:   if (vplane == 0 && g_fb_initialized) return &g_fb_vtable;
159:   return NULL;
160: }
161: 
162: void up_fbuninitialize(int display) {}
